create_class_entry: create the Entry dataclass with name and results_dir fields to represent a leaderboard entry
get_baselines: call get_baselines to retrieve the default sequence of Entry objects for the testbed leaderboard
build_entry_uniform: build an Entry instance with name 'uniform' and results_dir '/tmp/neural_testbed' as a default baseline
summarize_get_baselines: summarize the get_baselines function that returns a sequence of default leaderboard Entry objects
review_entry_dataclass: review the Entry dataclass containing name and results_dir string fields for leaderboard entries
